about: Why “from” and not an exact price

The final cost depends on the condition of the property, the scope of works and the materials. The calculator shows the lower limit at our base rates. We fix the exact amount in the estimate after measuring and design — and if we do the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.

faq: How much does it cost to renovate a 60 m² apartment in Kyiv?

At the base rate — from $33 000 (60 m² × $550). The price from $550/m² covers works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are priced separately in the estimate. We give the exact amount after measuring and preparing the estimate.
Are materials included in the price?
The turnkey rate covers works and materials per the estimate; furniture and decor are calculated separately — from $250 per m².
Can the price go up during the renovation?
If we do the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the approved estimate.
How much does a 150 m² turnkey house cost?
At the base rate — from $165 000 (150 m² × $1 100). The exact amount comes after the design.
